change.description: While the global KV cache is a sequential no-eviction identity prefix, compile the retained mixed40/local512/DPP-QK owner with physical_slot=logical_slot and every scanned token visible. This removes per-token base-offset, token-position, eviction-mask, shared physical-slot publication, and physical-slot LDS replay while preserving every QK product/addition, softmax operation, denominator update, ordered scalar PV FMA, gate, BF16 store, ABI, ownership, and dispatch.
